'''Death Star II Sealed''' is a sealed deck format in the [[Players Committee]]'s ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' (revised September 2015). Each player opens one Death Star II pre-constructed deck ([[Death Star II Starter Decks|Death Star II starter deck]]).<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' sealed deck
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee (Alternate Format Tournament Guide, 2015)
* '''Card pool:''' one Death Star II pre-constructed deck per player
* '''In use:''' listed in 2015; events not recorded
* '''GEMP:''' none (GEMP's [[Endor - Death Star II Sealed]] is a separate sealed league)

== Card pool ==
Each player needs one Death Star II pre-constructed deck. The format uses the guide's '''Sealed''' rules:<ref name="afg" />
* Product stays unopened until each player is paired with a first opponent and assigned a side of the Force for the whole tournament.
* Both players open everything at the same time and swap, face down, all cards of the other side. Each player keeps the cards received.
* Deck building time is 10 minutes for 40-card decks and 20 minutes for 60-card decks. Between games a player may re-customize from the original stock of sealed cards.

The guide does not give a deck size for this format. Sealed games are timed at one minute per card in the deck, with a Final Confrontation between the top Light and top Dark players at 1.5 times that length.<ref name="afg" />

== History ==
The same guide describes a related way to play the [[Death Star II Closed Environment|Battle of Endor Environment]] as sealed deck: each player gets a Death Star II pre-constructed starter deck plus several Endor and Death Star II boosters to draft from, taking cards of the starter deck's side.<ref name="afg" /> No event in Death Star II Sealed is recorded on this wiki.
